priorityList: When running Firestarter, delay your first Combustion until the target is below 90% health.

Cast Combustion when ready and then go into the Combustion Priority List, casting it near the end of a hard-cast Pyroblast (with Pyroclasm), Frostfire Bolt, or Scorch (when target is below 30% health).
Cast Meteor immediately as it becomes available, unless delayed more than 10 seconds, in which case save Meteor for Combustion.
Cast Pyroblast when you have Hot Streak after a non-instant Frostfire Bolt so they both land at the same time (Pyroblast Chaining).
Cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as your filler to generate Hot Streak / Heating Up.
Cast Scorch as filler when on the move and unable to cast Frostfire Bolt.
In the Combustion Priority List, cast Meteor between 2 to 8 seconds of Combustion left.
In the Combustion Priority List, cast Pyroblast when you have Hot Streak.
In the Combustion Priority List, cast Scorch when you have Heat Shimmer and no Hot Streak.
In the Combustion Priority List, cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
In the Combustion Priority List, cast Frostfire Bolt as filler.
In the Combustion Priority List, cast Scorch as filler when on the move and unable to cast Frostfire Bolt.
